name: Age of the Margraves
description: Ostarrichi, 996: a border march of farmers, hedge-shrines and wooden halls.

name: Age of AEIOU
description: Frederick III carves his five-vowel cipher; the first adepts learn to draw the Aether current.

name: Age of the Golden Lane
description: Rudolf II's alchemists in Prague crack the secret of Aether; casters and heroes rise.

name: Age of Reform
description: Maria Theresa and Joseph II: Aether engines, air rifles and bound beasts.

name: Age of the Congress
description: The Empire is proclaimed and Vienna dances at the Congress: great Aether-works, steam and statecraft.

name: Age of the Aether Monarchy
description: 1914, the shot in Sarajevo misses: a federal empire of airships, wonders and the AEIOU ritual.

name: Age of the Federation
description: The 1920s: an empire of equal crown lands, jazz in the coffeehouses, radio in every parlour.

name: Age of Zeppelins
description: The early 1930s: Aether zeppelins moor over the Ring, and the wireless carries the Emperor's voice.

name: Age of Diesel
description: The late 1930s: motor works, heavy tanks and concrete; steam gives way to the diesel engine.

name: Age of Radar
description: The 1940s: radar against the séance-fog, rocket batteries and the long winter war.

name: Age of the Atom
description: The late 1940s: Lise Meitner splits Aether; jets, reactors and a weapon no one should use.

name: Age of Rockets
description: The 1950s: rockets, glass and steel, and a treaty that outlives the century.
